description: February 29 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 2, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 29 birthday falls in Pisces, in the second decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a February 29 birthday
paragraphs: The leap-day birthday arrives once every four years, and fittingly it sits at a threshold: about ten degrees into Pisces, where the Moon-sub-ruled second decan begins. Twenty-nine stays as master number 11, linked with intuition. Together they describe a deeply perceptive, emotionally attuned person who often feels slightly outside ordinary time.

By noon UTC on February 29, the Sun has normally reached roughly 10° of Pisces. That places the date in the Pisces decan that astrologers give to Moon, the second of three. The Moon, which rules Cancer, acts as sub-ruler for Pisces between 10 and 19 degrees, roughly the first ten days of March. This decan tends to turn the sign's compassion towards home, family and the people closest at hand. Early-March birthdays are often linked with nurturing, intuitive and emotionally receptive temperaments, with long memories and a deep need to feel safe. The lunar influence can make moods ebb and flow in quick cycles. When they look after their own emotional tides as carefully as they tend other people's, these Pisceans often become the steady harbour that others return to.

sections.heading: Numerology of the February 29 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same February 29 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 7 for 1992, 6 for 2000 and 9 for 2012. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: February 29 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 29 is the 60th day of a leap year, the date that exists only once every four years. In most years Aries season is under way by March 21, 21 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a February 29 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. February 29 is also the birthday of Gioachino Rossini (1792), Pedro Sánchez (1972) and I. Bartholomeos (1940).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 29?
faq.answer: February 29 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 29 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 5 in 1972, 22 in 1980, 7 in 1992, 6 in 2000, 9 in 2012 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 29?
faq.answer: By February 29 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 29?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a February 29 birthday are Gioachino Rossini (1792), Pedro Sánchez (1972) and I. Bartholomeos (1940). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
